feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain continuing early tonight. Fresh to strong southeast winds. Comments: Strong winds. Coastal overtopping around high tide (~11pm). Risk of localised flooding due to heavy rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

15-30


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 20-25 with gusts of 30-35 in exposed areas at first.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain becoming patchier through the night (Tuesday night). Fresh to strong southeast winds. Minimum temperature 6°C. Any lingering patches of rain will soon clear on Wednesday morning, leaving the rest of the day dry and largely cloudy, with clear intervals developing in the evening. Moderate to fresh southeasterly winds becoming mainly moderate in the afternoon. Maximum temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds until the morning.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 at first.


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 20-25, soon decreasing 15-20, backing east or southeast later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Thursday, 26 November 2026##

Dry at first and during the daytime on Thursday with variable amounts of cloud. Cloud then thickening later with a few outbreaks of rain arriving early in the night. Moderate to fresh southeast winds increasing strong later, top temperature 7°C. Comments: Strong winds soon developing. Risk of gales in exposed spots later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 7°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5 later.


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

East or southeast 15-20, soon increasing southeast 20-25, then 25-32 later in the evening with the risk of 35 and gusts up to 45 in places later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain later. Patchy hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 27 November 2026##

Outbreaks of rain continuing through the night into Friday morning, then becoming dry with some sunny intervals developing through the day. Strong southeasterly winds at first, soon easing to light or moderate, with a top temperature of 8°C. Comments: Risk of gales at first, then strong winds. Risk of heavy rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-15


##Wind Speed##

26


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 25-32, occasionally 35 with gusts of 45 at first, soon veering west or northwest 10-15 for a time, then settling south or southeast later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 28 November 2026##

Cloudy with a risk of rain at times on Saturday. Light to moderate south or southeast winds increasing moderate to fresh and gradually veering west. Top temperature of 9°C. Comments: Strong winds in places later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-10


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

South or southeast 10-15, veering southwest 15-20, occasionally 25, then veering west or southwest later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.
